## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!tictactoe` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --sky: #38b6ff; --yellow: #ffc93c; --violet: #7c5cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --tray: #ffe4cf; --size: min(86vw, 272px); }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(155deg, var(--violet), var(--pink)); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  header { width: var(--size); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .pill { height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cream); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .25); white-space: nowrap; }
  #status { min-width: 0; font-weight: 800; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .score { flex: none; padding: 0 9px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .score b { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; margin-right: 3px; }
  .dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--pink); }
  .dot.o { border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sky); }
  #board { flex: none; width: var(--size); aspect-ratio: 1; padding: 8px; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--tray); box-shadow: 0 6px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .28); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
  .cell { position: relative; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #efc9ab; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s ease, opacity .2s ease; }
  .cell:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #efc9ab; }
  .cell:disabled { cursor: default; }
  .cell.x { background: var(--pink); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c92f66; }
  .cell.o { background: var(--sky); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #1f86c9; }
  .cell::before, .cell::after { position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: auto; }
  .cell.x::before, .cell.x::after { content: ''; width: 56%; height: 14%; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--ink); transform: rotate(45deg); }
  .cell.x::after { transform: rotate(-45deg); }
  .cell.o::before { content: ''; width: 52%; height: 52%; border-radius: 50%; border: calc(var(--size) * .045) solid var(--ink); }
  .cell.pop { animation: pop .32s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1); }
  .cell.win { animation: bounce .7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--ink), inset 0 0 0 4px var(--yellow); }
  #board.done .cell:not(.win) { opacity: .45; }
  @keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(.6); } }
  @keyframes bounce { to { transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.04); } }
  #again { flex: none; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c98f00; font: 800 15px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .1s ease; }
  #again:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c98f00; }
  .confetti { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .cell.pop, .cell.win { animation: none; } .cell, #again { transition: none; } }
</style>
<header>
  <span id="status" class="pill" aria-live="polite">Your move</span>
  <span class="pill score"><i class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></i>You <b id="you">0</b><i class="dot o" aria-hidden="true"></i>Bot <b id="bot">0</b></span>
</header>
<div id="board" role="grid" aria-label="Tic-tac-toe board"></div>
<button id="again" type="button">New round</button>
<script>
  var TEXT = { move: 'Your move', thinking: 'Bot is thinking…', win: 'You win! 🎉', lose: 'Bot wins', draw: 'Draw' };
  var LINES = [[0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],[0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8],[0,4,8],[2,4,6]];
  var board, over, thinking, last, round = 0, score = { you: 0, bot: 0 };
  var boardEl = document.getElementById('board');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('status');
  var cells = [];

  function winner(b) {
    for (var i = 0; i < LINES.length; i++) {
      var l = LINES[i];
      if (b[l[0]] && b[l[0]] === b[l[1]] && b[l[1]] === b[l[2]]) return { mark: b[l[0]], line: l };
    }
    return b.indexOf('') === -1 ? { mark: 'draw', line: [] } : null;
  }

  function minimax(b, turn) {
    var w = winner(b);
    if (w) return { score: w.mark === 'O' ? 1 : w.mark === 'X' ? -1 : 0 };
    var best = { score: turn === 'O' ? -2 : 2, move: -1 };
    for (var i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      if (b[i]) continue;
      b[i] = turn;
      var s = minimax(b, turn === 'O' ? 'X' : 'O').score;
      b[i] = '';
      if ((turn === 'O' && s > best.score) || (turn === 'X' && s < best.score)) best = { score: s, move: i };
    }
    return best;
  }

  function botMove() {
    var free = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < 9; i++) if (!board[i]) free.push(i);
    var move = Math.random() < 0.2 ? free[Math.floor(Math.random() * free.length)] : minimax(board.slice(), 'O').move;
    thinking = false;
    play(move, 'O');
  }

  function play(i, mark) {
    if (over || board[i] || (mark === 'X' && thinking)) return;
    board[i] = mark;
    last = i;
    var w = winner(board);
    if (w) {
      over = true;
      if (w.mark === 'X') { score.you++; statusEl.textContent = TEXT.win; confetti(); }
      else if (w.mark === 'O') { score.bot++; statusEl.textContent = TEXT.lose; }
      else statusEl.textContent = TEXT.draw;
      render(w.line);
      return;
    }
    if (mark === 'X') {
      thinking = true;
      statusEl.textContent = TEXT.thinking;
      var thisRound = round;
      setTimeout(function () { if (thisRound === round) botMove(); }, 350);
    } else {
      statusEl.textContent = TEXT.move;
    }
    render([]);
  }

  function render(line) {
    boardEl.className = over && line.length ? 'done' : '';
    for (var i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      var cell = cells[i];
      cell.className = 'cell' + (board[i] ? ' ' + board[i].toLowerCase() : '') + (i === last ? ' pop' : '') + (line.indexOf(i) !== -1 ? ' win' : '');
      cell.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Cell ' + (i + 1) + (board[i] ? ', ' + board[i] : ', empty') + (line.indexOf(i) !== -1 ? ', winning line' : ''));
      cell.disabled = over || thinking || !!board[i];
    }
    document.getElementById('you').textContent = score.you;
    document.getElementById('bot').textContent = score.bot;
  }

  function confetti() {
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    var cv = document.createElement('canvas'), w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight, r = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var g = cv.getContext('2d'), bits = [], colors = ['#ff4f8b', '#ffc93c', '#38b6ff', '#2ed8a7', '#7c5cff', '#ff8a3d'], t0 = 0;
    cv.className = 'confetti';
    cv.width = w * r;
    cv.height = h * r;
    document.body.appendChild(cv);
    for (var i = 0; i < 70; i++) bits.push({ x: w / 2, y: h * 0.45, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10, vy: -3 - Math.random() * 9, s: 6 + Math.random() * 5, a: Math.random() * 6, c: colors[i % colors.length] });
    function frame(now) {
      if (!t0) t0 = now;
      var t = now - t0;
      g.setTransform(r, 0, 0, r, 0, 0);
      g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      g.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - t / 1500);
      bits.forEach(function (b) {
        b.vy += 0.3; b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy; b.a += 0.2;
        g.save(); g.translate(b.x, b.y); g.rotate(b.a); g.fillStyle = b.c; g.fillRect(-b.s / 2, -b.s / 4, b.s, b.s / 2); g.restore();
      });
      if (t < 1500) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else cv.remove();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function reset() {
    round++;
    var old = document.querySelectorAll('.confetti');
    for (var k = 0; k < old.length; k++) old[k].remove();
    board = ['', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''];
    over = false;
    thinking = false;
    last = -1;
    statusEl.textContent = TEXT.move;
    render([]);
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
    var cell = document.createElement('button');
    cell.type = 'button';
    (function (index) { cell.addEventListener('click', function () { play(index, 'X'); }); })(i);
    cells.push(cell);
    boardEl.appendChild(cell);
  }
  document.getElementById('again').addEventListener('click', reset);
  reset();
</script>
`

client.command('tictactoe', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Tic-tac-toe",
    height: 380,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "Tic-tac-toe opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Height | 380 px |
| Size | 8.3 KB |
| Input | Tap |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
